hooks.name: Validate API Keys Before Task Execution
hooks.description: Checks that required .env API keys (AUDITTEST_API_KEY) are present before executing tasks that make LLM calls

action.command: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path '.env') { $content = Get-Content '.env' -Raw; if ($content -match 'AUDITTEST_API_KEY=.+') { Write-Host 'API key found in .env'; exit 0 } else { Write-Error 'AUDITTEST_API_KEY not set in .env file. Add it before running LLM tasks.'; exit 2 } } else { Write-Error '.env file not found. Create it with AUDITTEST_API_KEY=your_key'; exit 2 }"
